errors.evidence: The values for the HWER-Dov group are overestimated. The actual values are approximately 21.5, 22.5, and 23. The value for the green bar (24) is particularly inaccurate, as it is clearly closer to 23.
The description translates both HWER and WER as "词错误率" (word error rate), which is ambiguous and confusing as they are distinct metrics.
